instruction: Decline tomorrow's 1:1 with Jordan and suggest Thursday instead.
final_text:
I declined tomorrow's Jordan / Sam 1:1 (Wed 30 Sep, 3:30–4:00pm). Jordan got the decline with a note asking to move it to Thursday at the same time, 3:30–4:00pm. You're free then, between Investor update prep (2–3pm) and the Hiring sync (4–5pm). The note also asks Jordan to suggest another Thursday time if that one doesn't work.

Jordan set up the 1:1, so Jordan will need to move the invite. If you'd prefer, I can send you a new invite for Thursday instead.
